text: Reitan Retail is one of the three independent companies in REITAN, covering the business areas REMA 1000 Norge, REMA 1000 Danmark, Reitan Convenience and Uno-X Mobility.
short: Reitan Retail (incl. Uno-X Mobility and REMA 1000) is one of Reitan AS's three companies.

source.name: Reitan: Våre eiere (Our owners)
source.quote: Reitan Retail er ett av tre selvstendige selskaper i REITAN, og omfatter forretningsområdene REMA 1000 Norge, REMA 1000 Danmark, Reitan Convenience og Uno-X Mobility.
source.note: English: 'Reitan Retail is one of three independent companies in REITAN, and covers the business areas REMA 1000 Norway, REMA 1000 Denmark, Reitan Convenience and Uno-X Mobility.'
